title: Initial configuration with stored word
statement: Let $k$ be a positive number of work tapes, let $S$ be a state set, and let $s\in S$ and $x,w$ be Boolean words. Define a configuration on input $x$ in state $s$ with output empty, with the first work tape initialized to contain $w$, and with every other work tape blank.
hypotheses_covered: A positive number $k$ of work tapes
A state set $S$ and state $s\in S$
Boolean word $w$ stored on the first work tape
caveat: The construction uses the upstream initial-configuration and buffer-tape definitions, whose exact head positions and tape layout are not included in the supplied descriptions.
